name: Flesh Golem

source.note: The 2024 Flesh Golem. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against SRD 5.2.1 or the book. Unsure: the Hit Points, the Slam's Lightning damage and the Berserk trigger. Aversion to Fire, Berserk and Immutable Form are text only. Krezk's Vasilka uses this block under her own name.

languages: understands Common and one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Aversion to Fire
traits.summary: After taking Fire damage it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Berserk
traits.summary: Starting a turn Bloodied, it rolls a d6; on a 6 it attacks the nearest creature (or an object) every turn until it is no longer Bloodied.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.summary: Effects that would change its shape don't work on it.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.summary: Lightning damage heals it instead: it regains Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Slam
actions.summary: A heavy blow that also shocks.

summary: A stitched-together brute: two shocking slams, healed by lightning, hampered by fire, and liable to rage when hurt.
